**What would you like this tool to do?**

**Why is this needed?**

What's the use case? If it's a new invoice format/layout, a currency,
or a discount phrasing this tool doesn't handle, a redacted or synthetic
sample invoice is helpful.

**Is this in scope?**

This tool is intentionally narrow: text-layer PDF invoices, not OCR or
full accounting/compliance software. Please check
[`docs/limitations.md`](../../docs/limitations.md) first.
